headline: Record margins and profit growth prompt a raised outlook
summary_short: Garmin posted record Q2 revenue of $2.02B (+11.4% y/y) and operating income of $615.5M (+30.3% y/y), prompting a raise to full-year 2026 guidance.
summary_long: Revenue rose 15.3% q/q and 11.4% y/y to $2.02B, with growth across all five segments led by Fitness (+25% y/y) and Marine (+14% y/y); Outdoor was the lone decliner (-2% y/y). Gross margin expanded 360bp y/y to 62.4% on favorable product mix and roughly $21M of tariff-refund credits. Operating income rose 30.3% y/y to $615.5M and diluted EPS rose 35.3% y/y to $2.80. Garmin generated $276M of free cash flow, paid a $1.05/share dividend, and repurchased $43M of shares, ending the quarter with $4.4B of cash and marketable securities. Citing a strong first half, management raised FY2026 guidance to ~$8.05B revenue and $10.00 pro forma EPS.

drivers.explanation: Growth across all five segments, led by Fitness (+25% y/y) on strong wearables demand; Outdoor was the only segment to decline (-2% y/y) on weaker consumer-auto and adventure-watch demand.
Gross margin expanded 360bp to 62.4% on favorable product mix across segments and approximately $21 million of refunds of previously paid tariffs.
Growth outpaced revenue as gross-margin expansion offset a 9% rise in operating expenses; R&D and SG&A rose 10% and 8% on higher personnel-related costs.
EPS growth tracked net income growth; the effective tax rate ticked up to 16.8% from 16.5% a year ago due to a shift in income mix by jurisdiction.
CEO cited outstanding results with double-digit revenue growth and margin expansion across every segment, giving management confidence to raise full-year 2026 revenue and EPS guidance.
